steps.fact: CRM record NBA-102 lists the account name as "Northbridge Analytics".
Billing invoices use the billed name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."

Commercial notes state that sales uses "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", describing naming variants rather than establishing a shared legal identifier.
A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC", introducing a separate registry candidate.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs treating the registry link as unresolved.

No shared legal identifier (e.g., registration number, EIN) links crm:NBA-102 to billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc., and the relation contract does not license transitive closure (algebra.transitive is false).

support_claim: Although CRM NBA-102 and billing both reference closely related Northbridge Analytics name variants, the packet preserves multiple live registry candidates and explicitly states legal has not determined the contracting party, so identity between crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. cannot be established.
